blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two siblings face criminal charges after sending online threats to target a school in Lipa City, Batangas, with police recovering gadgets now under examination. “It started back in August. A particular school in Lipa City kept receiving online threats — specifically, threats to wipe them out,” said PNP public information office chief Col Allen Co in a press briefing on Tuesday. “We tracked them down and located them. We were able to secure a warrant to seize, examine, and search computer data, and we confirmed that the threats were indeed originating from them… It had become alarming; it […]...
